title: Wild AG section title
description: An uppercase section title in a light serif italic (51px at desktop, 40px on phones, line-height 0.95), filled with the taupe-to-sand brand gradient, or plain light on gradient bands. It fades up as it scrolls into view.
notes: needs a display serif with an italic (the theme's Inria Serif italic 300)
tone 'light' is for titles that sit on the gradient bands
